name: Con Dao 2 Days 2 Nights
desc: Con Dao - the gem island in the East Sea with pristine wild beaches and a rich marine ecosystem.
highlights: Spiritual - historical - island sea journey to Con Dao
Visit Hang Duong Cemetery & Co Sau's grave at night
Swim at Dam Trau beach, explore the Con Dao prisons
Round-trip high-speed ferry Tran De - Con Dao

🕯️ A SPIRITUAL - HISTORICAL - SACRED ISLAND JOURNEY

content.text: 🗓️ DETAILED TOUR ITINERARY
🌙 NIGHT 01: BIEN HOA / HCMC - TRAN DE (SOC TRANG)
⏰ 21:00 - 22:00 | 🚍 PICK-UP & DEPARTURE
TodayTourist coach and guide pick you up at the meeting point in Bien Hoa / HCMC, then head to Tran De (Soc Trang). Guests rest overnight on the coach.
🌅 DAY 01: TRAN DE - CON DAO | SPIRITUAL & ISLAND JOURNEY
⏰ 05:00 | ARRIVE TRAN DE PORT - light breakfast at a local restaurant, then board the high-speed ferry to Con Dao.
🚢 Around 10:00 arrive Con Dao. Coach picks up the group for sightseeing:

items: 🛕 Ba Phi Yen Temple (An Son Mieu) - a sacred temple tied to Con Dao history and local spiritual life.
🕍 Nui Mot Pagoda (Van Son Tu) - visit, pray and enjoy a panoramic view of Con Dao from above.

content.text: 🍽️ Lunch at a local restaurant - 🏨 check in hotel & rest
🌊 AFTERNOON: SIGHTSEEING & BEACH SWIMMING

items: ⛩️ Tho Than Shrine
⛩️ Hoang Tu Cai Shrine
🏖️ Dam Trau beach - free time to swim and relax at one of Con Dao's most beautiful beaches.

content.text: 🌙 EVENING: VISIT CO SAU'S GRAVE - HANG DUONG CEMETERY
🍲 Dinner at a restaurant. 🕯️ Night visit to Hang Duong Cemetery - in the sacred space, pay respects to national heroes and especially to Co Sau (Vo Thi Sau).
🛏️ Overnight at Con Dao hotel.
🌤️ DAY 02: CON DAO - TRAN DE - BIEN HOA / HCMC
🥐 Breakfast at the hotel, then sightseeing:

items: 🏛️ Con Dao Museum - learn about the formation and heroic struggles of this sacred land.
🏚️ Phu Hai Camp - French & American Tiger Cages - Phu Binh Camp - explore the famous prison system and the resilient spirit of the revolutionaries.

content.text: 🚐 Back to the hotel to check out. 🛍️ Con Dao Market - free time to buy local specialties and dried seafood as gifts.
🍽️ Lunch, then take the high-speed ferry back to Tran De and the coach back to Bien Hoa / HCMC. 👋 End of tour.
